conviction_note: Nel gives no financial guidance and the quarter's order intake (about USD 20m of Collins submarine stacks) is already out, so the release's new lines are revenue against a NOK 303m Q3'25 comparison that had alkaline milestones in it, cash after the USD 7.5m Iwatani payment, and an update on the NOK 296m HYDS backlog flagged as at risk. No consensus could be sourced, so every finding is capped small. abs_move 5.5 comes from the name's own results-day median of 4.3% (9 quarterly prints) and the measured European base for new numbers; p_up 42 because 7 of the last 9 quarterly prints fell and the stock ran +9% in five sessions on non-print news (Rheinmetall MoU, a Q4 order). Findings sum -1.6 and the scaled number is -0.9; both lean the same way and the gap is just the findings' small caps against a p_up kept near 50.

new_in_release.expect: Revenue below Q3'25's NOK 303m, which had alkaline milestone recognition in it; the deliverable backlog (NOK 377m for all of 2026 at 30.06) points to roughly NOK 150-250m. Likely a YoY decline in the headline, down

Backlog quality: what happened to the NOK 296m HYDS position, where one project was 'delayed' and the other 'needs to be reevaluated'. A removal or cancellation would be new, down; a confirmation would be mildly up
Cash falls from NOK 1,328m after the roughly NOK 70m Iwatani payment, Herøya pressurized-alkaline line capex and operating burn, so likely about NOK 1.1-1.2bn. Down, mostly anticipated
None given; Nel publishes no numeric guidance. Outlook text on FIDs for 50-150 MW projects, unknown
A possible CEO successor announcement (the notice runs out about mid-December). Sign unknown

findings.finding: Q2 report backlog note: NOK 296m of PEM backlog (24% of the NOK 1,213m total) is in 'significant risk of delay or cancellation'. One HYDS project is delayed and the other 'needs to be reevaluated after changed external circumstances'. The Q3 report is the first update, and a removal from backlog would be a new headline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Backlog-risk headlines have hit this name before: on 2025-02-24 E24 ran '40 prosent av Nels ordrebok kan bli kansellert' around the Q4'24 print. Nel's results days fell on 7 of 9 quarterly prints since Q3'23 (e.g. -9.53% on Q1'24, -12.7% on Q1'26).
findings.why_not_priced: The risk was disclosed in July, so the possibility is partly priced. What is not known is the outcome. Nothing from HYDS, HyFuel or Kaupanes has appeared since November 2025 (searched in Norwegian and English), so the market has no update. If a cancellation were already priced, the stock would not have run +9% in five sessions on order news.
findings.independence: none. The project FID and the original USD 50m order are from https://nelhydrogen.com/press-release/nel-asa-receives-pem-purchase-order-from-the-hyfuel-and-kaupanes-hydrogen-projects-valued-at-more-than-usd-50-million/, and nothing since then points either way.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue compares against NOK 303m in Q3'25, which Nel said was helped by alkaline milestone recognition. Q1-Q2 2026 ran at NOK 148m and 153m, and only NOK 377m of backlog was planned for delivery over all of 2026 at 30.06, so a large YoY revenue decline is the likely headline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue lag drove the August broker cuts: JPMorgan's target went from NOK 2.90 to 1.80 and Jefferies flagged the backlog-to-revenue gap. On Q2'26 itself (revenue -12% YoY, record order intake) the stock rose 1.84%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the brokers already cut on revenue lag (https://www.boerse-express.com/news/articles/nel-asa-aktie-jpmorgan-senkt-auf-180-kronen-936044, 2026-08-06). With no Q3 consensus findable, the size of the YoY drop is unknown to me and may be known to the market. Capped small because the bar is unsourced.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 report backlog schedule (NOK 377m planned for delivery in 2026): https://nelhydrogen.com/press-release/nel-asa-second-quarter-2026-financial-results/

findings.finding: Q3 cash flow carries the USD 7.5m Iwatani settlement payment ('Cash flow impact of USD 7.5 million in Q3 2026', per the Q2 presentation) plus Herøya pressurized-alkaline line capex (500 MW to be installed by end-2026), so cash likely falls from NOK 1,328m toward about NOK 1.1-1.2bn. The year before, cash was NOK 1,757m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no isolated cash-led reaction in the history; the E24 coverage and the boerse-express pieces of 2026-08-06 both cited the shrinking cash pile alongside the CEO exit as weighing.
findings.why_not_priced: The Iwatani payment and the capex plan are disclosed, so this is mostly priced. What is new is the net figure, including working capital and any customer advances on the Collins and US orders, which could offset. Small, and the sign is not fully determined.
findings.independence: The Q2 report text on capex, restricted cash and the EU grant: https://nelhydrogen.com/press-release/nel-asa-second-quarter-2026-financial-results/ (same company, different document).

findings.finding: Q3 order intake is pre-released: about USD 20m (about NOK 190m at 9.5 NOK/USD) of Collins Aerospace submarine stack orders 'will be booked as order intake in the third quarter of 2026', against NOK 57m in Q3'25. Q4 has already opened with a USD 12m order from a US technology customer (13 Oct).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose 2.6% on 14 Oct after the USD 12m order, and was roughly flat (+1.9%, +0.5%) on the 29-30 Sep Collins orders. Q1'26 fell 12.7% on results despite a USD 7m order announced five days earlier.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: each order was filed as inside information and the stock reacted on the day. Filed at 0 because a number the market has already been told carries nothing on results day unless the total surprises, for instance through unannounced small orders.
findings.independence: Oslo Børs NewsWeb inside-information filings 683213 (2026-09-29) and 684037 (2026-10-13).

findings.finding: CEO Håkon Volldal resigned on 15 June 2026 with a six-month notice period, to run Elopak from about January 2027. As of 14 Oct no successor has been announced, and the Q3 release or call may name one.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The resignation was announced at 14:36 UTC on 2026-06-15. No isolated reaction was measured.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether and whom is unknown, so there is no sign to price; sized 0.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly negative, in line with priced_lean_pct of -0.345. The +8.9% five-day run-up was on non-print news (the Rheinmetall MoU, a Q4 order), which adds sell-the-news risk rather than cutting against the lean. The disclosed short is a small, stable 0.59%, not fuel.
language_note: E24 (Norwegian) supplied the dated reaction to the Rheinmetall MoU: 'Nel-aksjen hoppet 6 prosent' (13 Oct). It also carried the CFO's on-record framing that the fuel 'møter NATOs dieselkrav', which the English release does not contain.

E24's archive confirmed there was no 2026 Herøya layoff ('varsel om oppsigelser') and no Q3 preview. Every filing (orders, Q2 report, backlog-risk note, calendar) was in English on NewsWeb, so the Norwegian sources added context and nothing load-bearing.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the pre-released Q3 order-intake finding went from +0.3 to 0.0.

'You were right about the number and too small about the move': abs_move_pct went from 5.0 to 5.5. The period's numbers are new, but the order intake is pre-released and there is no guide, so not up to the 7% base. p_up stays at 42 on the reaction history (7 of 9 quarterly prints fell).
